documentation_basis: PostgreSQL 18 documentation; no database setup is implied
source_location: Private generation directory selected explicitly; never public/dist/Git. Resolve partition paths from its manifest, not guessed filesystem glob traversal.
scope: Lossless generation-scoped relational import proposal for existing collections. Live SaaS CRUD tables, authentication and accounting postings are separate future implementations.

identity.id: Use exported deterministic UUIDv5 unchanged. Original app identity remains source_record_id text.
identity.tenant_id: Use manifest tenant_id and assert each record matches; never derive a tenant by matching names.
identity.generation_id: Use manifest generation_id. Same entity ID in a later generation is preserved as a separate snapshot version.
identity.future_current_state: Do not overwrite prior snapshot records with a blind upsert. A future live (tenant_id,id) model needs its own version/conflict and authority policy.

json.amount: decimal string in major currency units

money.postgres: numeric plus char(3); preserve null and exact source decimal text in archived payload
money.forbidden: Do not reinterpret amount as minor units, use binary float, infer missing currency or convert unknown to zero.

type_rules.decimal: Normalized numeric source attributes are strings; cast only after decimal validation. Source number precision cannot be reconstructed.
type_rules.date: YYYY-MM-DD to date with calendar validation; null stays null.
type_rules.month: YYYY-MM stored as text with calendar-month check, no invented first-day event.
type_rules.timestamp: Validated ISO timestamp to timestamptz; source fields without timezone do not silently assume local timezone.
type_rules.raw: Native cell/source metadata/source_attributes and unmapped attributes remain JSONB; byte-for-byte native files remain in a private raw archive.
type_rules.jsonb: Do not rely on object key order. Preserve array order where semantically significant.

rules: Raw files and source cells are lineage/archive, never payment/ledger postings.

Preserve each supplement classification from its source; apply the exporter default only when no classification was supplied. Do not promote supplement payloads to household actuals without an explicit validated mapping.
observations are separate from domain.payments and projections.

checks: Validate manifest hash/bytes/counts, file boundaries and normalized generation first.
No new data import when the source generation is invalid.
Load one generation into isolated staging using parameterized input/COPY appropriate to the selected PostgreSQL version.
Preserve source collection, source id and record payload; reject duplicate primary keys and unexpected collections.
Create tenant/generation context, taxonomy, source lineage and domain entities in dependency order.
Normalize declared child arrays; validate typed targets, vocabulary ownership and missing references.
Compare collection counts and IDs with manifest; hash retained raw payloads.
Compare exact payment amounts/currencies and forecast measures independently.
Do not reconcile by summing subtotals, balances, plans and actual payments together.
Use one transaction for validated generation promotion; rollback all writes on failure.
Same tenant+generation repeat verifies the existing content and performs no duplicate insert.
Conflicting same-generation content is an error, never an overwrite.
RLS and role policy must be designed and tested before SaaS data access; JSON tenant fields are not authorization.
Test a restore and idempotent re-import in a disposable database.
No live DB change or schedule is installed by this mapping.
